title: LIMITED-TIME SPECIAL EVENT
lines: 01 COMMEMORATIVE LOGIN EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Ansel's Exclusive Outfit, Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Module Materials, and more.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 4: Chip Catalyst * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 5: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Celebration Frame furniture * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Day 8: Epoque Collection outfit - Nighttime Café for Ansel * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Module Data Block * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
NOTE: Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CELEBRATION - KERNEL
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Celebration - Kernel], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from [Kernel Headhunting]:

Exusiai / Siege / Ifrit / Eyjafjalla / Angelina / Shining / Nightingale / Hoshiguma / Saria / SilverAsh / Skadi / Ch'en / Schwarz / Hellagur / Magallan / Mostima / Blaze / Aak / Ceobe / Bagpipe / Phantom / Rosa / Suzuran

During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Kernel Operator from the list of available Operators. If all available 6-star Operators are already owned, the first 6-star Operator obtained will be a random 6-star Operator from the list of available Operators.

The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Celebration - Kernel] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Celebration - Kernel] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Celebration - Kernel] banners.

During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the number of rolls without obtaining a 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any other banner, and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other banners.
NOTE:

During the [Celebration - Kernel] banners, all available 6-star, 5-star, and 4-star Operators will be featured in Kernel Headhuntings. When obtaining an Operator through [Kernel Headhuntings], Universal Certificates and Kernel Tokens will be granted if you already own a Kernel Operator.
03 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CELEBRATION - VISTA

DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Celebration - Vista], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from a past Headhunting Pool up to and including [To Bloom From a Dim Flame Standard Headhunting]:

Weedy / Thorns / Eunectes / Surtr / Blemishine / Mudrock / Mountain / Archetto / Saga / Passenger / Kal'tsit / Carnelian / Pallas / Mizuki / Saileach / Fartooth / Flametail / Gnosis / Lee / Goldenglow / Fiammetta / Horn / Irene / Ebenholz / Dorothy / Pozëmka / Młynar / Stainless / Penance / Reed the Flame Shadow
NOTE:
[Celebration - Vista] is part of the [Special Headhunting] headhunting series.
Please refer to the official notice of the [Special Headhunting] for more details.
04 LIMTIED-TIME SPECIAL PACK AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time. Purchase limit: 2.
Headhunting Pack - Kernel
CONTENT: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1
